traditional: A hard contact. Love, money, and pleasure works against growth, fortune, and patronage - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas. Two benefics: among the easiest contacts, though it can incline to excess.
modern: Pleasure meets expansion. Gentleness, generosity, sensitivity, and a great deal of ease. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Play-before-work and indulgence undercut accomplishment. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for connection against growth, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the connection/growth form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity collides with excess and overreach; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.summary: It is possible to have too much of a good thing once every extra yes starts asking for money, time, or energy you did not originally agree to give.
readerCopy.body: It is possible to have too much of a good thing once every extra yes starts asking for money, time, or energy you did not originally agree to give. When Venus squares Jupiter, generosity and appetite expand together, making another upgrade, invitation, purchase, promise, or person feel easy to add because each choice looks harmless on its own. Eventually the cost shows up in the part of your life expected to absorb all that abundance. Notice when more stops making the experience better and starts making you responsible for maintaining something you no longer have room to enjoy.
